items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Jean, I have never heard of Jean since she made that record with us.

ctx.x: Jean, I have never heard of Jean since she made that record with us. She was the one that made 'I Want Something to Live For', Jean Eldridge -- very fine, very

fine. I don't know why she quit or why she changed over, but we never heard much more of Jean. She was originally from Buffalo, I think, and I don't know whether she just wanted to go home or whether she had some differences with the powers that be or what.
